evidence.observation: Frozen at 63.4-63.5 °C for 21 min while other column temperatures move
Implausibly high (~445 °C) and flat, inconsistent with T703 ~74 °C reboiler
Slow oscillatory drift with no net column heat-up; no top-section response
Distillate and reflux flows essentially zero/noise, no steady reflux established
Pressure drop stays ~0.7 mbar, indicating negligible vapour traffic

args.missing_evidence: Setpoints/heater duty commands and an independent check of T701 and the upper-section thermocouples (T705/T711/T712) to distinguish sensor fault from genuine absence of boil-up.
